name: MyTripPlanner
description: MyTripPlanner — self-hosted road-trip planner with Ulisse, the built-in AI travel agent. Real hotels, restaurants, maps, budget. Open source.

paragraphs: Plan road trips by talking. Ulisse — an AI agent running on your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription — interviews you, then builds the whole itinerary live: stops, real roads on the map, timings, budget, real hotels from Booking.com and real restaurants from Google Maps.
Self-hosted · no API keys · no accounts · your data stays in your Documents folder
features: Agent-built trips — a new trip starts as a full-screen conversation: Ulisse asks everything it needs in one interactive question carousel (single choice, multi choice or free text — swipe through, answer all, send…

Real hotels from Booking.com — for every night Ulisse runs a live Booking.com search (headless Chrome on your machine, no API keys): real names, real total prices for your exact dates, availability flags, prefilled deep…

Real restaurants from Google Maps — same treatment for food: live Google Maps data (rating, review count, the average per-person price — the "€20–30" you see on Maps — category, coordinates), ranked so solid review…

A live notebook — Ulisse takes structured notes after every single answer (enforced at the tool layer, not just prompted) and the notebook card fills in next to the chat in real time; it is re-injected on every turn as…
Trip currency — pick EUR or USD before the first message; every price in the app and in the agent's work uses it (the fuel estimate converts through a daily-refreshed exchange rate).

whatItDoes.text: Plan road trips by talking. Ulisse — an AI agent running on your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription — interviews you, then builds the whole itinerary live: stops, real roads on the map, timings, budget, real hotels from Booking.com and real restaurants from Google Maps.

requirements.text: Self-hosted · no API keys · no accounts · your data stays in your Documents folder
In-app chat (floating panel over the map on desktop, its own tab on mobile) with two subscription-powered engines: Claude (Agent SDK, Pro/Max login) and Codex (OpenAI Codex CLI, ChatGPT sign-in).
